mission: Coverage gap check D9 (owner request 2026-10-16), Step 1: add two reviewed read-only db-diagnostic SQL files that classify every active verified print without a fresh Yuyu-Tei price (never discovered, discovered but identity unresolved or mapping not approved, mapped but not refreshed, every same-release listing mapped to a sibling) by rarity and base vs parallel, with the survey sample prints; register them in ops-readonly; and let the db-diagnostic summary carry rows that fit the ops-summary annotations. Staging only; no collector, setting, mapping, enqueue, price, identity, Market Value/Index, secret or Railway change; no runbook run in this PR.

impacts.reason: Two SELECT/WITH-only diagnostics (7 statements) over card_prints, canonical_cards, release_products, source_card_mappings, freshness_work, freshness_price_states, yuyutei_candidates, yuyutei_discovery_runs and source_mapping_proposal groups/alternatives. Run only through ops-readonly db-diagnostic (default_transaction_read_only=on, statement timeout). No write, no source request.

The db-diagnostic summary also carries the result rows when their compact JSON is at most 24,000 characters (fits the 9 x 3000 ops-summary annotations), else rows_omitted. Same rows as the artifact file; no new query, request or write; assert_clean still scans every output.
Adds yuyu-coverage-gap and yuyu-coverage-gap-samples to the db-diagnostic choice list (tests keep it equal to the files present). No permission, secret, environment or trigger change.

Covers the summary rows/rows_omitted rule and that a summary at the limit is not truncated in the annotations. The existing Postgres test runs every diagnostic, the new ones included, in a read-only session.
Documents that the db-diagnostic summary carries rows when they fit.

impact.deployment_impact: Ops tooling, SQL, test and doc only. collector_services is empty and no raw_dependency_migration: 0 collector rollouts, no DDL. No path under services/, packages/ or apps/ changes.

recovery.procedure: Native revert of this PR removes the two diagnostics and their workflow choices and restores the count-only summary. No data, schema, provider or service configuration to undo.
recovery.trigger: A db-diagnostic run that fails the read-only check, exceeds its statement timeout, or whose summary or artifact shows anything but query rows.
recovery.backup: Not applicable: no schema or row change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue.

verification.observation_window: After merge: one ops-readonly db-diagnostic run per new file completes with status ok and read_only true, and its summary carries rows or rows_omitted.
